chunks: So, the intercession of intercessors will not avail them.
ai.seo_question: Why will intercession not benefit certain people on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse clarifies that intercession (Shafa'ah) is not an automatic right but is contingent upon Allah's permission and the intercessor's own merit, often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores that mere association with the righteous is insufficient without personal faith and divine approval, a nuance highlighted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni.
